tools.name: wire_size
tools.description: Minimum conductor size for a circuit: NEC Table 310.16 ampacity at the termination temperature rating, the 240.4(D) small-conductor limits, voltage drop over the run, and the Table 250.122 equipment grounding conductor, increased in proportion under 250.122(B) when voltage drop upsizes the conductor

tools.name: voltage_drop
tools.description: Voltage drop for a given conductor size, current and one-way length, single- or three-phase, from NEC Chapter 9 Table 8 circular mils (VD = 2·K·I·L / CM, or √3 for three-phase).

tools.name: watts_to_amps
tools.description: Current drawn by a load in watts at a voltage and power factor, single- or three-phase, plus the 125% continuous-load value.

tools.name: conduit_fill
tools.description: Percent fill and maximum number of THHN/THWN-2 conductors of one size in EMT or PVC Schedule 40, from NEC Chapter 9 Tables 1, 4 and 5.

tools.name: box_fill
tools.description: Minimum outlet box volume from NEC 314.16(B): conductor, device (2 each), clamp and grounding allowances times the Table 314.16(B) volume for the largest conductor.

tools.name: load_calculator
tools.description: Dwelling service load by the NEC 220.82 optional method: 3 VA/ft² lighting, small-appliance and laundry circuits, fixed appliances, demand factor, heating or cooling, and the minimum standard service size. Leave an appliance out to count it as 0 VA.

tools.name: ohms_law
tools.description: Ohm's law and power: give exactly two of voltage, current, resistance and power; the other two are calculated.

tools.name: panel_schedule
tools.description: Lays circuits out on a 120/240 V single-phase or 208Y/120 V three-phase panel and totals the load per phase with the imbalance.

tools.name: bid_calculator
tools.description: Electrical bid price from materials, markup, labor hours and rate, job costs, overhead and a target net margin (price = break-even / (1 − margin)).

tools.name: nec_ampacity
tools.description: Allowable ampacity of one insulated conductor from NEC Table 310.16 (not more than three current-carrying conductors in a raceway or cable, 30°C ambient), before any adjustment or correction factors and before the 240.4(D) small-conductor limits.
